com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc

Class SchemaElement

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc.SchemaElement
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<SchemaElement>

    public class SchemaElement
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Iterable<SchemaElement>
    Represents an element of the Schema. This element can be a discrete element or a composite element that is made up of one or more elements or composite elements.
    Since:
    01-024-0000
    Author:
    ICE Data Services
